meta.title: PsyScripts — 31 lightweight scripts for web developers

demo.name: Name (3+ chars)
card.HeaderMenu: Responsive burger menu, Esc & outside click
card.CopyButton: One-click copy for text or elements
card.ScrollReveal: Reveal on scroll, respects reduced motion
card.Toast: Notifications from JS or an attribute
card.Dropdown: Dropdown menu with arrow keys & Esc
card.Tooltip: Tooltips that stay inside the viewport
card.StickyTOC: Auto table of contents with active highlight
card.Skeleton: Skeleton loading until content is ready
card.I18n: Translations: JSON, plurals, fallback, auto language, RTL
demo.sub: Every script is live and configurable. Change options and watch the result and events.
install.more: Single scripts, icons and configuration — in the
d.tabs.pa: First panel. Arrow keys, Home and End switch tabs.
d.tabs.pc: Third panel — aria-controls is set for you.
d.acc.p: Single or multiple open, animation speed, open/close/openAll API.
d.acc.q3: Can I control it from JS?
d.acc.a3: Yes: Accordion.open(), .close(), .openAll() and the accordion:toggle event.
d.dd.p: Hover mode, keyboard support, tooltips with placement and delay.
d.tip.delay: I appear after a 400 ms delay
d.theme.p: Any number of themes: add your own with configure + setTokens.
d.nav.p: The header menu highlights the section (ScrollSpy), the burger works on mobile, back-to-top is bottom right.
d.modal.p: Native <dialog>, close options and the Promise-based Modal.confirm().
d.toast.p: Position, type, duration, title, action button, progress bar and pause on hover.
d.toast.title: Saved
d.cookie.p: Consent categories and expiry. Read it with Cookie.has("analytics").
d.car.p: perView, responsive breakpoints, autoplay, loop and events — change them live.
d.cmp.p: Before/after comparison: mouse, touch and keyboard, horizontal and vertical modes.
d.tw.p: Typing text: words, speed, loop. Respects reduced-motion.
d.marq.p: The ticker fills the container width on its own; speed and pause via API.
d.rev.p: Five reveal effects. Distance and duration are global options.
d.px.p: Parallax on the Y/X axis and a manually controlled skeleton.
d.form.p: Custom rules (data-rule, data-match), validation modes, form:invalid and psy:valid events.
d.cnt.p: Easing curves, duration, animate to any value with Counter.set().
d.cd.p: Countdown to a date and a "+45" second timer, localized labels through Intl.
d.copy.p: Copy with a toast, and a page reading progress indicator (top bar + this one).
d.i18n.p: Plurals via Intl.PluralRules, language switching without reload.
o.title: title
cz.title: Customize & API
cz.sub: Pick a preset, tweak colors, shape and behavior — the page updates instantly, contrast is checked against WCAG and the code is ready to copy.
cz.tokens: Colors apply to the selected theme: switch between light and dark at the top.
card.Typewriter: Typing text with words, speed and loop
card.Countdown: Countdown to a date or a timer, labels via Intl
card.ScrollProgress: Reading progress for the page or a block
card.CompareSlider: Before/after slider for mouse, touch and keyboard
scripts.empty: Nothing found — try another word or category.
card.CommandPalette: Ctrl/⌘+K command palette: fuzzy search, groups, recent items
card.DataTable: Table: sorting, search, pagination, safe CSV export
card.Sortable: Drag by mouse, touch or keyboard with screen-reader announcements
d.cmd.p: Press Ctrl/⌘+K anywhere. Searches commands and navigation links; recent items are remembered.
cmd.label: Command palette
d.dt.p: Click a header to sort (aria-sort), search across all cells, pages, CSV export protected against formula injection.
d.sort.p: Drag the handle, or press Space on it and use the arrows; Esc cancels. Changes are announced to screen readers.
d.safe.p: Any HTML is parsed in an inert document and rebuilt from allowed nodes only: scripts, event handlers, javascript: links and styles are removed.
install.each: Individual scripts: core + the file you need
install.eachNote: Every script is https://psyscripts.vercel.app/dist/<name>.min.js (after core.min.js); the path and SRI hash for each one are in the docs and in the “Files” section.
cz.a11y.note: WCAG 2.2: body text needs 4.5:1 (AA), 7:1 is AAA; outlines and UI components need 3:1.
cz.import.err: Could not parse: valid JSON is required.
cz.empty.css: Change colors or shape — CSS variables will appear here
